text: Ɓen habbittooɓe on bone maa moƴƴere, si on dañii polgal on heɓii konuheyri, ɓe wi'ana on : "E men wonndaano e mo'on, men tawdaa ko tawdaa ko tawdaɗon ?! Fii no ɓe heɓira geɓal, si heeferɓe ɓen heɓii geɓal, ɓe wi'ana ɓe : "E men toppitanooki on, men etii no fooliron men reeni on gomɗimɓe ɓen ?! Alla Ko Ñaawoyoowo hakkunde mo'on fow Ñalnde Darngal ; O Naada gomɗimɓe ɓen Aljanna, O Naada naafiqii ɓe ɓen ka ndenka ɓurka joltude ka nder yiite, Alla Waɗirantaa Heefer- ɓe ɓen Ɓural Makko ngal hujja e gomɗimɓe ɓen Ñalnde Darngal, si ko woni, O Waɗanay gomɗimɓe ɓen battane moƴƴe.
